rubric: common includes every negative, including the common reading in sense pairs; sense and advanced are positive references above B1
limitations: Synthetic challenge set enriched for paired senses; not a representative sample of webpage vocabulary.
Two examples within each lemma group are correlated; groups never cross calibration and holdout.
Independent agent review is not teacher validation or an authoritative CEFR dictionary label.
Repeated occurrences do not validate selecting only the second occurrence with a different meaning in production DOM rendering.
No full-plugin baseline comparison; numeric gates alone do not establish production readiness.
